Button Guard · Button brace grants shields to its row.
Sock Skipper · Pocket skip steals 1 shared energy and hits the rear.
Spool Ram · Every third round charges a double-power front-row sweep.
Needle Moth · Needle rain applies Scald to the rear row.
Teacup Healer · Refills the most wounded ally by 65 HP.
Kettle Knight · Reflects 12 damage per hit while its shield holds.
Yarn Giant · Every third round Loomfall sweeps the front and Tangled threads appear.
Binding Thread · Knots apply Tangle to the weakest cat.
Practice Cushion · A gentle third-round bump teaches a break interrupt.
Pollen Scout · Every third round plants a Binding Thread, up to two.
Rain Spool · Every third round Cloudburst washes shields away before a row hit.
Crumb Sentinel · Every third round Sugar burst detonates Crumb trails on cats.
Pantry Crown · Every third round Empty banquet drains energy and silences the table.
